detail: SEBI Regulation 31(4) requires immediate disclosure when a person acquires 25% or more shares in a listed company. This filing by Vinod Kumar Jain in SRG Housing Finance Limited marks the commencement of takeover code obligations. The disclosure does not specify the exact shares acquired or the acquisition price, as these details are typically in the sealed envelope submitted separately to the exchange. Pending the formal open offer announcement, the acquirer is subject to trading freezes and disclosure restrictions.
